newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Thailand's SAS Trading in Vietnam cement venture.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's SAS Trading in Vietnam cement venture.

text.p: Vietnam's Mine & Energy Engineering Company signed a contract on Monday with S.A.S. Trading Company Ltd of Thailand to set up a joint venture cement plant in the northern province of Quang Ninh.
Invested capital for the project, the Quang Hanh Cement Joint Venture Company, was $237.82 million, said a statement released at the signing ceremony in Hanoi.

The Thai investor will hold 60 percent of the company's legal capital for the first 18 years of the venture. From the nineteenth year, the Vietnamese partner can increase its equity by one percent per annum until its share reaches 49 percent.

Construction of the plant, which will have the capacity to produce 4,000 tonnes of clinker a day and 1.4 million tonnes of cement a year, will start at the end of this year and production is expected to begin at the end of 2000.
